# apple_app_clip_app_store_review_detail (Resource)

Sets the invocation URLs App Review uses to launch a default App Clip experience. An experience has one App Review detail: the resource creates it, or manages the existing one. App Store Connect can't delete it, so destroying the resource leaves the URLs in place. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_clip_app_store_review_detail" "card" {
  default_experience_id = apple_app_clip_default_experience.card.id
  invocation_urls       = ["https://example.com/order"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_experience_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the default experience, e.g. `apple_app_clip_default_experience.example.id`.
- `invocation_urls` (List of String) URLs that launch the App Clip, e.g. `["https://example.com/order"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip's App Review detail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_clip_app_store_review_detail.card
  identity = {
    id = "4c6e8a0b-2d4f-4a6c-9e1b-5d6e7f8a9b0c"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip's App Review detail.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_clip_app_store_review_detail.card 4c6e8a0b-2d4f-4a6c-9e1b-5d6e7f8a9b0c
```
